The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal portfolio of wind farms, for a given level of risk, increases with the number of wind farm sites and with their concentration in the portfolio.
the Markowitz Frontier is not a straight line but a concave curve, which implies that a portfolio of wind power generators should not be diversified in a uniform way.
